name: Gitea
description: Use a self-hosted Gitea for project repositories, agent Git access, repository tools and the review bot.

methods.whenToUse: Use a Gitea access token with a gitea-mcp server you run in HTTP mode.
methods.guidanceMd: Run `gitea-mcp -t http -H https://<your Gitea>` behind HTTPS, then enter your Gitea host, the gitea-mcp host and a Gitea access token. Paperclip sends the token to gitea-mcp per request; agents also use it for Git over HTTPS on the Gitea host.
methods.label: Use an access token

tenantFields.label: Gitea host
tenantFields.helperMd: Hostname of your Gitea instance, without https:// or a path. Paperclip uses it for repository access, Git over HTTPS and the review bot.

tenantFields.label: Gitea HTTPS port
tenantFields.helperMd: Leave 443 unless your Gitea serves HTTPS on another port.

tenantFields.label: gitea-mcp host
tenantFields.helperMd: Hostname where you run `gitea-mcp -t http` (behind HTTPS). Paperclip connects to https://<host>:<port>/mcp.

credentialFields.label: Gitea access token
credentialFields.helperMd: Create the token in Gitea under Settings → Applications. Give it repository read and write, issue and pull request access for what agents should do. Paperclip uses the same token for Git over HTTPS.

warnings: A token is a secret; do not put it in a URL. The token cannot exceed its owner's Gitea access.
gitea-mcp exposes write tools that create issues, pull requests, branches and commits. Review the discovered catalog and Paperclip action policies.

methods.whenToUse: Sign in with a Gitea OAuth2 application you register, through a gitea-mcp server running with -oauth.
methods.guidanceMd: Run `gitea-mcp -t http -oauth -oauth-public-url https://<gitea-mcp host> -H https://<your Gitea>`. In Gitea, create an OAuth2 application under Settings → Applications with the callback URL below, then enter its client ID and secret. A person signs in once; Paperclip refreshes the token and uses it for repository tools and Git over HTTPS.
methods.label: Use your own Gitea OAuth2 app

tenantFields.label: Gitea host
tenantFields.helperMd: Hostname of your Gitea instance, without https:// or a path. Paperclip uses it for repository access, Git over HTTPS and the review bot.

tenantFields.label: Gitea HTTPS port
tenantFields.helperMd: Leave 443 unless your Gitea serves HTTPS on another port.

tenantFields.label: gitea-mcp host
tenantFields.helperMd: Hostname where you run `gitea-mcp -t http` (behind HTTPS). Paperclip connects to https://<host>:<port>/mcp.

warnings: Gitea OAuth2 tokens carry the signed-in user's full Gitea access unless the application is restricted.

methods.whenToUse: Run gitea-mcp on the Paperclip server over stdio with a Gitea access token.
methods.guidanceMd: Install the `gitea-mcp` binary on the Paperclip server's PATH (for example `go install gitea.com/gitea/gitea-mcp@latest`). Paperclip starts it per connection with your Gitea host and token.
